visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man (Lawrence) speaking directly into a black microphone. (2) The scene cuts to a second person (Joni) with short black hair and glasses, wearing a tan zip-up jacket. They are also holding a microphone and gesturing with their left hand. The setting is consistent with the previous shot, illuminated by soft indoor lighting. (3) The camera returns to Lawrence as he continues his explanation, his facial expressions shifting from serious to slightly smiling. He is seated in a similar indoor environment with visible equipment cables in the lower frame. (4) A transition shows Joni speaking again, leaning forward slightly as they explain a concept. He continues to hold the microphone close to his mouth. (8) Joni mentions a Korean drama, and a poster for 'Love in the Big City' is superimposed over their upper body. (9) Lawrence nods and smiles broadly, gesturing towards the camera with high energy. (10) A series of shots depict an exhibition at a historical-style building with red brick walls and wooden beams. A person in a long light-colored dress is seen briefly walking through the exhibition space.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台 Hahatai. [Variety]: 社群 - 勞倫斯. [Subtitle]: 假設今天 (你) 有HIV. (2) [Subtitle]: 會不會就... 不敢去愛人. (3) [Variety]: 主持人 - 傑尼. [Subtitle]: 小時候聽到愛滋的時候, 就會覺得. (4) [Subtitle]: 感覺是一個疾病嘛, 就有點害怕. (5) [Subtitle]: 但現在可能因為醫療技術發展, 好像... 變得比較可控. (6) [Subtitle]: 比較像是慢性病, 然後也有宣傳那個U=U嘛. [Variety]: U = U, Undetectable=Untransmittable. (7) [Subtitle]: 你如果檢測不到病毒, 它就是不會有傳染力. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以基本上就跟一般人一樣, 甚至是可以生兒育女的. (9) [Subtitle]: 這些藥物啊, 還有這些治療技術發展起來後. (10) [Subtitle]: 就不會像以前覺得, 愛滋病, 有些人會覺得有點害怕之類的. (11) [Subtitle]: 相對來說, 男同志對於這方面的知識就會比較齊全. (12) [Subtitle]: 異性戀如果不知道這些資訊的話, 他們可能相對來說. [Variety]: 恐懼跟不理解. [Subtitle]: 就會越來越嚴重. (13) [Subtitle]: 我覺得他們應該很少會知道PrEP這個東西. (14) [Subtitle]: 也可能很少知道U=U是什麼意思. (15) [Subtitle]: 對, 我覺得這個概念好像在一般異性戀的族群裡面. (16) [Subtitle]: 他們比較缺乏, 因為他們可能覺得, 好像跟我沒關係. (17) [Subtitle]: 而且他們很容易會是在已經發病了之後, 他們才會知道. (18) [Subtitle]: 自己有HIV這件事情, 所以其實會更嚴重. (19) [Subtitle]: 前陣子有看一個那個韓劇嘛. (20) [Subtitle]: 大都市的愛情法, 其他裡面也是有提到HIV這個東西. (21) [Variety]: 拜託請大家去看. [Subtitle]: 你很有共鳴是不是? (22) [Variety]: 因為他寫得很真實. [Subtitle]: 我很有共鳴, 因為他寫得很真實. (23) [Subtitle]: 所以我們就回到這個展, 就是要跟大家說. (24) [Subtitle]: 同志諮詢熱線的愛滋小組, 在這20年間對HIV這個議題. (25) [Subtitle]: 在台灣做了哪些的努力. (26) [Subtitle]: 從2月20號到3月2號, 就在台北市的剝皮寮. (27) [Subtitle]: 邀請您一同看見, 汙名如何在男同志與感染者的生命中, 留下痕跡. (28) [Subtitle]: 詳情請到熱線的官網看囉.
